title: Clean temporary files
description: Delete leftover files from your user and Windows temp folders.
why: Apps and installers leave scratch files in temp folders and rarely clean them up. Files that are currently in use are skipped, so it won't break anything that's running.

title: Clear shader caches
description: Remove DirectX, NVIDIA and AMD shader caches.
why: Shader caches can grow to several GB or get corrupted, which sometimes causes stutter. Games rebuild them on the next launch, so the first launch afterwards can be a little slower.

title: Clear Windows Update cache
description: Delete downloaded update files that Windows no longer needs.
why: Windows keeps the installers of past updates in SoftwareDistribution\Download. Clearing it frees space and can fix an update that is stuck.
danger: Updates that were downloaded but not yet installed have to be downloaded again. Don't run this while Windows is installing updates.

title: Empty Recycle Bin
description: Permanently delete everything in the Recycle Bin.
why: Deleted files keep using disk space until the Recycle Bin is emptied.
danger: Everything in the Recycle Bin is deleted permanently and can't be recovered.

title: Flush DNS cache
description: Clear Windows' cached website address lookups.
why: Fixes sites that won't load after a DNS change or an outage. Windows simply looks the addresses up again.
